name: 角色动作
summary: 给已有角色做一批动作精灵图，保持角色完整留在画面内，并支持无缝循环
description: 绑定角色包里的一个角色，每个条目做一个动作（走、跑、待机、攻击、死亡……）的序列帧，输出精灵图、atlas JSON 和 GIF 预览。AI 起草会按绑定角色的外形描述动作；新建时点“添加常用条目”会一次填进待机、走、跑、冲刺、跳跃、下落、攻击、重击、施法、防御、受击、死亡、胜利、拾取 14 个动作，不要的行删掉即可；预设会保持参考角色原有外形，不假设角色有手脚；球形角色会滚动、弹跳来表现移动。镜头固定，角色缩小并留有安全边距，降低运动时撞到画面边缘的风险。动作描述用英文、分步骤写效果更稳（先做什么、再做什么）。循环会在视频生成时锚定首尾姿势并寻找接缝，平滑循环整段正放、把结尾叠化进开头（不倒放）；跳跃预设为连续弹跳循环，攻击、死亡等仍是单次播放。动作名会作为文件名和精灵图帧名的前缀（如 walk_0000），不填则按序号。动画一步用 Wan2.1 14B，每个动作约需 8 到 10 分钟，14 个动作要好几个小时，建议只留需要的。14B 的动作幅度偏小，走、跑这类动作截出的循环段可能很短（实测一个走路动作只截到 4 帧、接缝被标为需检查），不满意可以重新生成换一个随机种子。

options.label: 循环（走、跑、跳跃，自动找接缝）
平滑循环（待机、呼吸，不倒放）
消失（消散、传送，末尾画面清空）
横屏（横向位移大的动作，角色会变小）
小方形（体型小的角色，生成最快）

presets.name: 待机
presets.prompt: the character gently rocks, bobs, or shifts its weight in place, calm subtle idle motion using only its existing body form

presets.name: 走
presets.prompt: the character moves forward in place with steady repeating locomotion suited to its original shape; a round character rolls or makes small rhythmic hops

presets.name: 跑
presets.prompt: the character moves quickly in place using its original body form; a round character rolls and bounces faster, smooth repeating motion

presets.name: 冲刺
presets.prompt: the character makes a fast forward dash in place using its original body form; a round character rolls rapidly or makes a strong forward hop, smooth repeating motion

presets.name: 跳跃
presets.prompt: the character repeatedly gathers itself, springs high into the air, reaches the peak, falls and lands, then rebounds into the next jump in a smooth continuous bouncing cycle

presets.name: 下落
presets.prompt: the character falls through the air in place, rotating or tumbling naturally according to its body shape, then continues a smooth repeating fall

presets.name: 攻击
presets.prompt: the character winds up with a brief rock or spin, then lunges, rolls, or bounces forward into a quick body-led strike, follows through, then returns to its ready position

presets.name: 重击
presets.prompt: the character gathers force, then launches or slams its body downward with a strong impact, holds for a moment, then recovers

presets.name: 施法
presets.prompt: the character gathers glowing energy around its body, releases a pulse of energy outward, then the glow fades

presets.name: 防御
presets.prompt: the character braces its whole body and holds position behind a brief protective shimmer, then relaxes back to its ready position

presets.name: 受击
presets.prompt: the character is hit: its whole body jolts, recoils, and wobbles, then steadies and recovers to its original pose

presets.name: 死亡
presets.prompt: the character loses momentum, tips or rolls down to the ground, then settles and lies still without changing its original shape

presets.name: 胜利
presets.prompt: the character celebrates with joyful rhythmic bounces, a happy spin, or another small movement suited to its body shape

presets.name: 拾取
presets.prompt: the character moves toward a small object on the ground and interacts with it using only its existing body shape or appendages, then returns to its ready position

params.prompt_suffix: 2D game sprite animation, fixed locked camera, keep the entire character visible and centered in every frame with generous empty safety margins on every side; no cropping, no camera pan, no zoom; preserve the exact character design, silhouette, colors, face, and anatomy from the reference in every frame; express motion only through the character's existing body form, plain white background, empty white space, no ground, no floor, no extra objects, the character performs the action in place
